goal: Build a self-hosted cloud relay platform with a cloud control plane, protocol-specific relay services, a node agent, and a web management console.
constraints: UDP and P2P must be reserved without full implementation
Management must support a future desktop client through a reusable API
acceptance_criteria: Working agent register and heartbeat flow
Node and server metrics API available
Protocol relay processes separated by service
Admin web shell can consume the API
assumptions: Single cloud VM in phase one
Future cloud-side Codex sessions will be used for joint debugging
